name: 云析
taglineEn: Android cloud-drive link parser and downloader
description:
粘贴分享链接，直接高速下载 —— 一个开源的 Android 网盘解析下载应用

识别夸克 / UC / 迅雷 / 百度 / 139 / 123 / 115 / 光鸭 / 蓝奏云 / 蓝奏云优享版 分享链接，自动匹配提取码，Range 分片并发 + 断点续传。
descriptionEn:
Paste a share link and download at high speed — an open-source Android app that parses and downloads cloud-drive shares.

It recognizes Quark / UC / Thunder / Baidu / 139 / 123 / 115 / Guangya / Lanzou / Lanzou Premium links, matches extraction codes automatically, and uses Range-based parallel chunks with resumable downloads.
author: CYQawa
